name: codegen
description: codegen has no third-party runtime dependencies; common-compile-settings is a build-only helper, consumed through the overlay port under support/vcpkg/ports like SGCT does, replacing what used to be a git submodule. This manifest exists so the repository configures through the vcpkg toolchain like Ghoul and SGCT. It is kept in sync by hand with the overlay port under support/vcpkg/ports/codegen; the only intentional difference is that the port depends on the vcpkg-cmake host tools explicitly.
